## Natural history notes

A small slant-faced grasshopper characterized by its narrow head, slender body, brown to greenish coloration, and spotted or dusky markings on the wings. In Florida, it is found throughout the state in open grassy habitats such as prairies, pine flatwoods, fields, roadsides, lawns, marsh edges, and disturbed areas where grasses and low vegetation are abundant. It feeds mainly on grasses and other herbaceous plants, usually staying low in vegetation or on the ground and escaping disturbance with quick jumps or short flights.
